title: Push Delivery — Signed Event Delivery Envelope
description: Body of the HTTPS POST a PACT server makes to a subscription URL or Mandate escalation_hook (§21.3). At-least-once: receivers deduplicate on (subscription_id, event.id). signature.value is computed over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this envelope with the `signature` member removed (§20.3 canonicalisation). Added in PACT v2.1 (§21).

delivery_id.description: Unique per delivery ATTEMPT. The event id, not this, is the idempotency key.

subscription_id.description: The subscription (or server-managed escalation-hook binding) this delivery serves.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt counter under the §21.3 retry policy.

event.description: The §6.1 event envelope being delivered, clearance-reduced per §17.13.

alg.description: Signature suite from the §20.3 registry (no HMAC/symmetric schemes).

value.description: base64url signature over the canonical envelope (see top-level description).
